articles.author: Chandrima Sanyal
articles.headline: ETF Inflows Hit Record $1 Trillion In H1 — But 800 Funds Missed The Party
articles.summary: Record ETF inflows topped $1 trillion in the first half of 2026, but most of the money is flowing to a small group of passive and active ETF winners.
articles._summary: The U.S. ETF industry is on track for another record year, but beneath the blockbuster inflow numbers, investors are increasingly funneling money into a relatively small group of funds while leaving hundreds of others behind. U.S.-listed ETFs attracted more than $1 trillion of inflows during the first half of 2026, marking the earliest the industry has ever crossed that milestone.
articles._zh_headline: 上半年 ETF 流入量创下 1 万亿美元新高——但 800 只基金错过了盛会
articles._zh_summary: 美国 ETF 行业有望再创历史新高，但在巨额资金流入背后，投资者越来越多地将资金投入到相对较小的基金群体中，而将数百只其他基金抛在后面。 2026 年上半年，在美国上市的 ETF 吸引了超过 1 万亿美元的资金流入，这是该行业有史以来最早跨越这一里程碑的。

articles.author: Chandrima Sanyal
articles.headline: Qualcomm's Edge AI Push Could Fuel the Next Leg Higher for Semiconductor ETFs
articles.summary: Qualcomm's growing edge AI ambitions and bullish analyst outlook could boost semiconductor ETFs as AI investing expands beyond Nvidia and data centers.
articles._summary: The renewed ETF interest comes as Qualcomm emerges as one of the biggest beneficiaries of the shift toward “edge AI,” where AI models run directly on smartphones, PCs, vehicles and other connected devices instead of relying solely on cloud infrastructure. SMH, with roughly $69.28 billion in assets, is the industry’s largest semiconductor ETF and is known for its concentrated exposure to mega-cap chipmakers.
articles._zh_headline: 高通的边缘人工智能推动可能推动半导体 ETF 的下一步走高
articles._zh_summary: ETF 的新兴趣正值高通成为向“边缘人工智能”转变的最大受益者之一之际，其中人工智能模型直接在智能手机、个人电脑、车辆和其他连接设备上运行，而不是仅仅依赖云基础设施。 SMH 资产约为 692.8 亿美元，是业界最大的半导体 ETF，以其集中投资于大型芯片制造商而闻名。

articles.author: Chris Katje
articles.headline: Tesla Robotaxis Could Be Blocked From New Jersey — And Elon Musk's Own Strategy Is Why
articles.summary: Elon Musk is anti-lidar, a stance that could cost him the ability to operate robotaxis in several states.
articles._summary: Tesla has expanded the states in which its robotaxis operate and looks to make autonomous vehicles a key part of its future growth. That plan could face a setback in New Jersey if a bill requiring autonomous vehicles to use cameras and other sensing technologies passes. The bill is expected to be voted on by New Jersey lawmakers later this year, as reported by The Verge.
articles._zh_headline: 特斯拉机器人出租车可能被新泽西州禁止——埃隆·马斯克自己的策略就是原因
articles._zh_summary: 特斯拉扩大了其机器人出租车运营的州，并希望将自动驾驶汽车作为其未来增长的关键部分。如果要求自动驾驶汽车使用摄像头和其他传感技术的法案获得通过，该计划可能会在新泽西州遭遇挫折。据 The Verge 报道，该法案预计将于今年晚些时候由新泽西州立法者进行投票。

articles.author: Mohd Haider
articles.headline: Why Is Arista Networks (ANET) Stock Trending Overnight?
articles.summary: Arista Networks shares rose 8.76% during regular trading and moved slightly higher after hours, with the stock trading near its 52-week high.
articles._summary: Arista Networks Inc. (NYSE: ANET ) shares are trending on Thursday. Shares of the California-based software-driven cloud networking solutions provider climb 0.017% to $181.08 after the bell on Tuesday. ANET closed the regular session up 8.76% at $181.05, according to Benzinga Pro data. Volume for the day rose to 11.91 million shares, compared with an average daily volume of 8.72 million shares, indicating elevated trading activity.
articles._zh_headline: 为什么 Arista Networks (ANET) 股票隔夜走势？
articles._zh_summary: Arista Networks Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：ANET）股价周四呈现走势。周二收盘后，这家总部位于加州的软件驱动云网络解决方案提供商的股价上涨 0.017%，至 181.08 美元。根据 Benzinga Pro 数据，ANET 常规交易日收盘上涨 8.76%，至 181.05 美元。当日成交量增至 1,191 万股，而日均成交量为 872 万股，表明交易活动有所增加。

articles.headline: Nvidia, Alibaba, Levi Strauss, MDA Space and Broadcom: Why These 5 Stocks Are on Investors' Radars Today
articles.summary: NVDA, BABA, LEVI, MDA, AVGO were among the stocks seen trending among investors on Wednesday, July 8, 2026.
articles._summary: Major U.S. indices ended Wednesday on a mixed note, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average falling 1.09% to 52,348.39, the S&P 500 slipping 0.28% to 7,482.21, while the Nasdaq gained 0.2% to close at 25,870.65. These are the top stocks that gained the attention of retail traders and investors through the day. Nvidia’s stock rose 3.65% to close at $204.12, after trading between an intraday low of $195.06 and a high of $205.16; the stock’s 52-week range is $161.16 to $236.54.
articles._zh_headline: 英伟达、阿里巴巴、李维斯、MDA Space 和博通：为什么这 5 只股票今天受到投资者关注
articles._zh_summary: 美国主要股指周三收盘涨跌互现，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌 1.09%，至 52,348.39 点；标准普尔 500 指数下跌 0.28%，至 7,482.21 点；纳斯达克指数上涨 0.2%，收于 25,870.65 点。这些是全天吸引散户交易者和投资者关注的顶级股票。英伟达股价上涨 3.65%，收于 204.12 美元，盘中低点 195.06 美元，高点 205.16 美元；该股 52 周区间为 161.16 美元至 236.54 美元。

articles._zh_summary: 在最近的一次采访中，传奇投资者比尔·阿克曼被问及为何看好以色列经济。问题在于阿克曼拥有特拉维夫证券交易所约 5% 的股份。 • Teva Pharmaceutical 股票交易处于高位。 TEVA 股票走向何方？ “从经济角度来看，我非常看好以色列，”阿克曼说。
